speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Look at that, there's even pasta left over.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Do you understand that this was supposed to be a date?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I do. Do you? Because frankly, you've been in a foul mood since I sat down.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Okay, here's my question, why did you sit down?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: To help. Look, if you fail at this relationship, and history suggests you will, then we risk losing the medical officer that our landing party has always needed.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: What landing party?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You're Kirk, I'm Spock, Wolowitz is Scotty, Koothrappali is the guy who always gets killed, and now we've got McCoy.

speaker: dr_stephanie_barnett
text: So, we're all standing around looking at the post-op x ray and there it is, clear as day, right in the guy's chest cavity, one of my earrings.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Oh, my god, what did you do?

speaker: dr_stephanie_barnett
text: What do you think I did? I discreetly slipped off the other earring, put it in my pocket and then got the hell out of there!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I have a bone to pick with you, sir.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Oo-oo-oh!

speaker: dr_stephanie_barnett
text: Hi, Sheldon.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Hi, Stephanie. I'm sorry I'm late, but your companion left the most indecipherable invitation.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: What invitation?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: We're going to the movies. What movie? What theatre? What time? If you were trying to make it impossible to locate you, you couldn't have done a better job.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Oh, clearly I could have.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: It took me nearly 20 minutes to go through the browser history on your computer to see what movie times you looked up. Wait here, I'll find us seats.

speaker: dr_stephanie_barnett
text: No, no, we have seats.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Not the right seats.
